description: The Cisco Aironet 1131AG, 1242AG, 1232AG, and 1310G access points deliver the versatility, high capacity, security, and enterprise-class features required for autonomous based Government deployments. In FIPS 140-2 mode of operation, the Cisco APs support the IEEE 802.11i standard and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). The Cisco APs are Wi-FI CERTIFIED for IEEE 802.11a, IEEE 802.11b and IEEE 802.11g radio standards.
